text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Share of an injected real solar farm's capacity that each fit finds (1 is all of it; farm injected at 50% of the Primary's pinned capacity, read at season-year 2024). Dot: median over five farms. Line: 80% interval from resampling whole months. Dashed line: a perfect recovery. Pooled: median over the five Primaries D5, D10, D11, D14, and D16; D9 is shown beside them. Fits use rows before 2026-07-01.'
text.tspan: Share of an injected real solar farm's capacity that each fit finds (1 is all of it; farm injected at 50% of the Primary's
pinned capacity, read at season-year 2024). Dot: median over five farms. Line: 80% interval from resampling whole months.
Dashed line: a perfect recovery. Pooled: median over the five Primaries D5, D10, D11, D14, and D16; D9 is shown beside them.
